    Vallejo Fourth of July Parade Committee announces cash-prize winners

    • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

    By Thomas Gase | tgase@timesheraldonline.com | Vallejo Times Herald
    PUBLISHED: July 20, 2026 at 2:23 PM PDT
    Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:22
    Instaread

    Two weeks after another successful Fourth of July parade in Vallejo, the parade committee announced the event’s winners.

    More than 70 businesses, clubs, schools, teams and dignitaries marched, rolled, karate kicked, danced and somersaulted their way through this year’s parade, viewed by an estimated 28,000 spectators.

    “The 171st Vallejo Fourth of July Parade was a wonderful celebration of our community, our nation’s independence, and the traditions that bring generations together,” said Shelee Loughmiller, Chair of the Vallejo Parade Association, in a news release. “The Vallejo Parade Association’s planning team is incredibly grateful to every participant, volunteer, sponsor, and supporter who helped make this historic 171st parade such a tremendous success.“

    This was the first year the parade awarded cash prizes of $250 for the winners.

    The “funniest” float turned out to be a team of dancing carrots, oversized bananas and twirling fruit, which made local juicer Sunshine Smoothies the first-place winner.

    Cash prizes also went to Class 1-A Commercial/amateur William Kim Taekwondo, while Ochoa Landscaping came in second place.

    Winning in the Class 1-B Non-Profit category was Mesai’s Merry Toy Drive, while the Filipino Community came in second place.

    The Class 5 Senior Cheer/Drill team award went to Vallejo High, while Jesse Bethel came in second place.
